description: Browse the public plan library by group (e.g. Basic Manners, Grooming & Handling, Positions, Tricks). Use when the user wants to see what can be trained or what a category holds, rather than an answer to one problem. Without `group`: every group with its plans' names, refs and urls. With `group`: that group's plans with summaries and step counts.

group.description: Optional group name, as list_plans (no arguments) returns it.

name: list_plans
title: Browse the plan library
